inbeing.m: The fact or state of being in.

inbeings.m: More than one inbeing. inbeing: the fact or state of being in.

inboards.m: More than one inboard. inboard: located within the hull or nearest the midline of a vessel or aircraft.

inbounded.m: Past tense of inbound. inbound: directed or moving inward or toward a centre.

inbounding.m: The -ing form of inbound. inbound: directed or moving inward or toward a centre.

inbox.m: A container in which papers to be dealt with are put.

inboxes.m: More than one inbox. inbox: a container in which papers to be dealt with are put.

inbreathed.m: Past tense of inbreathe. inbreathe: to breathe (something) in.

inbreathes.m: A form of inbreathe, as in “she inbreathes”. inbreathe: to breathe (something) in.

inbreed.m: To breed or reproduce with those that are related.

inbreeders.m: More than one inbreeder. inbreeder: one who engages in inbreeding.

inbreeds.m: A form of inbreed, as in “she inbreeds”. inbreed: to breed or reproduce with those that are related.
